summary: When the router cannot classify a request, its degraded answer names the reason UNCLASSIFIED, so the caller can tell a refusal from a routing failure.
subject: feat(router-agent): name the reason of an unclassified request
body: RouterAgent._fallback now returns reason UNCLASSIFIED with the UNSUPPORTED intent, and a test covers it.
changelog: The router's degraded answer names its reason, UNCLASSIFIED.

targets.why: the degraded answer of the router
